total_weight_zero_before_distribute.meaning: totalWeight has been brought to zero by voters calling reset in the next epoch's window, before the epoch emission distribution action

epoch_emission_minted.meaning: a minted epoch emission exists to be accounted to the reward flow

emission_accounted_to_reward_flow.meaning: the minted epoch emission is accounted to the reward flow (gauges' claimable) rather than left stranded in GaugeManager

protocol_level_loss_occurs.meaning: a protocol-level loss affecting all liquidity providers and voters occurs

assumptions: The checked action is the epoch emission distribution (distributeAll/notifyRewardAmount) performed after voters reset totalWeight to zero.
The minted epoch emission is the HYBR token amount produced by the minter for the epoch.
'Accounted to the reward flow' means the emission becomes claimable by gauges rather than remaining in GaugeManager.

unresolved.description: The report does not state a numeric or structural relation between totalWeight being zero and the emission being stranded; the loss is described only qualitatively, so the effect is modeled as a grounded Boolean outcome rather than a quantified relation.

limitations: The impact is asserted qualitatively as a protocol-level loss; no magnitude, affected amount, or per-actor loss figure is stated, so V is a Boolean occurrence rather than a quantified loss.
The report does not specify whether notifyRewardAmount is called directly or only via distributeAll; the action is modeled as the epoch distribution step.
The exact authorization of the keeper/minter caller is not specified and is not part of the selected P.
Only the selected impact protocol_level_loss_affecting_lps_and_voters is formalized here; other impacts are out of scope for this plan.
